set.input.play.help: Easy play: no arming (the first key or touch starts the motors). On a keyboard it flies like a game: click to capture the mouse, move the mouse to turn and to look up and down, W A S D to move, Space up, Shift down, and when you let go the drone stops and hovers in place. On a touch screen: sticks with altitude help and a pilot school. Pilot: as a radio — the ARM button or Space, a throttle that stays where you leave it, Mode 2 keys (W/S throttle, A/D yaw, arrows pitch and roll). A radio or a gamepad always flies as a radio.
set.input.altitudeHelp.help: The drone holds its height by itself; up and down (the left stick on a touch screen) climb and sink at a steady speed. Works in angle mode only: horizon and acro can flip, and there your throttle flies. Step 1 of the pilot school. The game keys on a keyboard always hold the height.
set.input.haptics.help: A short buzz when you crash with the touch sticks, on phones that allow it (most Android phones; not iPhone).
set.input.mouseSensitivity.help: How far the drone turns and the camera tilts for a movement of the mouse. 1 is 0.1 degrees for each pixel of movement. Works with the game keys, while the mouse is captured (click on the view).
set.input.mouseInvertY: Invert the mouse up and down
set.input.mouseInvertY.help: Off: moving the mouse away from you looks up, as in most games. On: it looks down, like a flight stick pulled back.
set.input.gameSpeed.help: How fast W A S D and Space / Shift fly: slow 4 m/s across and 3 m/s up, normal 8 and 5, fast 14 and 8. A small drone cannot always reach the fast speed: it flies as fast as its tilt and the air allow.
set.input.howToFly: Show "How to fly" when a scan opens
set.input.howToFly.help: A card with the keys, or the sticks, of the input you fly with: for a keyboard, Space up and Shift down, with the mouse and W A S D. It shows once each time you open the simulator. "Do not show again" on the card switches it off here too; K or the pause menu bring it back whenever you want.
play.game.mouse: look and turn (up and down tilts the camera)
play.game.move: move (the Up and Down arrows too)
play.catalog.forward: forward / back (the up and down arrows too)
play.game.clickHint: Click to fly with the mouse
play.game.angleOnly: The game keys fly in angle mode. For horizon or acro use the pilot keys (Settings, Controls).
play.keys.toggle: show the How to fly card
play.keys.pilotNote: Pilot keys as on a radio (Mode 2, Space arms): Settings → Controls.
play.card.title: How to fly
play.card.downSub: hold to descend, and to land
play.card.click: Press Start flying to capture the mouse. Esc lets it go.
play.card.padRightText: fly forward, back, left and right
play.card.radioSticks: Fly with your sticks, as set up on the Controls screen
play.card.radioArmSwitch: arm: flip the arm switch ({src}) with the throttle at the bottom
play.card.radioArmKey: arm: press Space or the ARM button
play.card.radioMode: flight mode: your mode switch, or M
play.gate.keys: Click to fly, or press W or Space to take off
play.gate.touch: Touch a stick to take off
play.touch.hint.climb: Left stick: up / down and turn. Right stick: fly.
play.touch.hint.throttle: Left stick: throttle (stays) and turn. Right stick: fly.
play.hud.keys: Space up · Shift down · K keys · F full screen · R respawn · Esc pause · H hide text
play.school.title: Pilot school
play.school.about: Each step takes some help away. Fly the seconds of a step without a crash to unlock the next one; you can pick any step.
play.school.step1.about: The drone levels itself and holds its height.
play.school.step2.about: It still levels itself; you hold the height with the throttle.
play.school.step3.about: Levels near the centre, flips at full stick.
play.school.step4.about: No self-levelling: how real FPV pilots fly.
play.school.reached: Goal reached: {goal} s without a crash!
play.school.finished: You fly acro without a crash. Real sticks are next: a radio or a gamepad connects on the Controls screen.
